ops.title: cc-sudo routed approvals: Studio to yasyf-forge setup facts (Oct 6 2026)
ops.body:
Lane cc-sudo-route, release-v3 drive. Verified headless on the Mac Studio, Oct 6 2026.

- Mesh names come from `synckitd status`. The Studio's self is `yasyf@yasyf-forge-studio.tail71af5d.ts.net`. The laptop's self is `yasyf@yasyf-forge.tail71af5d.ts.net`.
- A routed approval comes back with `signed_by` set to the approver's mesh self (synckit consent/engine.go Relay). cc-sudo then looks up `/etc/cc-sudo/trusted/peers/<signed_by>.pub`. So the trust argument must be the full mesh name, `sudo cc-sudo trust yasyf@yasyf-forge.tail71af5d.ts.net`. Plain `yasyf-forge` would enroll under a name that never matches.
- `/etc/cc-sudo/origin-host` on the Studio held `Yasyfs-Mac-Studio`, the gethostname default. It must be the mesh self, so install with `--origin yasyf@yasyf-forge-studio.tail71af5d.ts.net`. Doctor 0.12.0 fails the origin check on a mismatch.
- The laptop reaches over Tailscale SSH with no key (`PubkeyAuthentication=no` and `IdentityAgent=none` still succeed), so root's `ssh` in `cc-sudo trust` authenticates. root's known_hosts may lack the laptop, though, and BatchMode then refuses. One interactive `sudo ssh yasyf@yasyf-forge.tail71af5d.ts.net true` accepts the host key.
- The laptop runs synckitd 0.40.0 and cc-sudo 0.11.1 (cask). It has no `/etc/cc-sudo`, so `sudo cc-sudo install` never ran there. Its mesh lists only yasyf-home, not the Studio. The relay leg does not check mesh membership (consent/service.go handleRelay).
- PRs: yasyf/daemonkit#46 (AgentPaths(home:label:) public, v0.33.0), yasyf/cc-sudo#4 (protocol 2, 0.12.0).
